title: Waƙa da kiɗa
description: Ten short stories about music: an old Sokoto goge maker who teaches his grandson to build a fiddle, a Kano praise singer of the butchers at the Eid, a board that makes a young singer remove nakedness, an insult and a false charge from her video, a Bauchi singer who refuses to sing election propaganda, drummers at a millet harvest near Katsina, a grandmother's folk tale of a witch, a hyena and a singing crab, a Sokoto mechanic who becomes a Muslim after years of religious songs on the radio, a Zaria choir girl with a cold on competition day, a candlelit concert in Jos, and a Kano lawyer who stops the pirates of her grandfather's songs.

lessons.title: Gogen Malam Bilyaminu
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the old goge maker Malam Bilyaminu teaches his grandson Mahmud to build a fiddle: they choose a calabash bowl by its sound, soak a goat skin overnight, shave and scrape it, weigh it down with cement blocks to dry, cut it with scissors, fix it with a small hammer, twist horsehair into a string tied with a leather binding, and put all the parts together.
lessons.text:
Malam Bilyaminu yana yin goge a Sokoto tun yana matashi. Yanzu yana da shekara saba'in, kuma idanunsa ba sa gani sosai kamar a da. Saboda haka jikansa Mahmud, ɗan shekara goma sha shida, yana koyon sana'ar a wurinsa a lokacin hutun makaranta.

Wata safiya kakan ya ce, "Mahmud, yau za mu fara sabon goge. Wani mawaƙi daga Kebbi ya nemi a yi masa shi kafin Sallah."

Da farko suka je kasuwa domin su sayi ƙoƙo. Malam Bilyaminu ya ɗauki ƙoƙo ɗaya bayan ɗaya, yana buga su da yatsa yana sauraron sautinsu. A ƙarshe ya ce, "Wannan ƙoƙo yana da sauti mai kyau. Ƙoƙo shi ne zuciyar goge."

Da suka dawo gida, kakan ya fito da fatar akuya. Ya ce wa Mahmud ya saka ta a cikin ruwa. "Ka bar ta a cikin ruwa har gobe. Idan fata ba ta sha ruwa sosai ba, ba za ta yi laushi ba." Suka bar fatar a cikin bokiti dukan dare.

Washegari fatar ta sha ruwa, ta yi laushi. Kakan ya ba Mahmud reza, ya ce, "Ka aske gashin fatar a hankali. Kada ka yanke ta." Mahmud ya aske gashin duka, yana tsoron kada ya yi rami a cikin fatar. Sannan kakan ya nuna masa yadda ake kankare cikin fatar da wuƙa. "Ka kankare duk abin da ya rage a jikinta, har ta yi tsabta."

Suka shimfiɗa fatar a ƙasa, suka ɗora bulo a kowane gefe domin kada ta naɗe yayin da take bushewa. Bulo huɗu suka riƙe fatar har yamma.

Da yamma kakan ya ɗauki almakashi, ya yanke fatar daidai da bakin ƙoƙon. Ya ce, "A nan almakashi ya fi wuƙa, domin yana yanke fata daidai." Ya ja fatar a kan ƙoƙon, sannan ya ɗauki ƙaramar guduma, ya kafa wasu ƙananan ƙusoshi a gefen ƙoƙon. Mahmud ya karɓi gudumar, amma ya bugi yatsansa. Kakan ya yi dariya ya ce, "Duk wanda ya taɓa riƙe guduma, ya taɓa bugun yatsansa."

Washegari suka yi kirtani. Kakan ya fito da gashin wutsiyar doki, ya haɗa shi ya yi kirtani guda mai ƙarfi. "Goge yana da kirtani ɗaya kacal, amma wannan kirtani ɗaya yana iya yin kuka kamar mutum," in ji shi. Ya ɗaure kirtanin da maɗauri na fata a saman sandar goge. Ya ce, "Idan maɗauri bai yi ƙarfi ba, kirtanin zai sassauta a tsakiyar waƙa."

A ƙarshe suka harhaɗa komai: ƙoƙo, fata, sanda, kirtani da maɗauri. Malam Bilyaminu ya ce, "Harhaɗa goge kamar harhaɗa iyali ne. Kowane abu yana da wurinsa."

Kakan ya ja baka a kan kirtanin, goge ya yi kuka mai daɗi. Mahmud ya yi murmushi ya ce, "Kaka, shekara mai zuwa ni ma zan harhaɗa goge nawa."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Mahmud yake koyon sana'ar goge a wurin kakansa?
Domin kakansa ya tsufa, kuma idanunsa ba sa gani sosai.
Me ya sa suka bar fatar a cikin ruwa dukan dare?
Domin ta sha ruwa ta yi laushi.
Me Mahmud ya yi da reza?
Ya aske gashin fatar a hankali.
Me ya sa suka ɗora bulo a kan fatar?
Domin kada ta naɗe yayin da take bushewa.
Daga me suka yi kirtanin goge?
Sun yi shi daga gashin wutsiyar doki.

lessons.title: Mawaƙin mahauta
lessons.summary: In Kano, Malam Haruna has sung for the butchers for thirty years; before the Eid the butchers' leader Alhaji Sanusi, a man of great presence, invites him to sing at his house; Haruna sees the herd of rams for the poor and the women grinding pepper for suya, puts them in his song, and on the day of the Eid, after Sanusi hands sweets to the children, the mute boy Ɗanbala dances to the drums, the song reaches its peak and Sanusi dances with him and then embraces the singer.
lessons.text:
Malam Haruna mawaƙin mahauta ne a Kano. Tun shekara talatin yana yi wa mahauta waƙa a lokacin bukukuwa, kamar yadda mahaifinsa ya yi a da. Duk lokacin da aka yi idi, mahauta sukan ba shi kuɗi da nama.

A wannan shekara, kwana uku kafin idi, shugaban mahauta, Alhaji Sanusi, ya kira shi. Alhaji Sanusi mutum ne mai kwarjini. Idan ya shiga kasuwa, kowa yakan tashi ya gaishe shi, har yara ma suna jin kwarjininsa.

Alhaji Sanusi ya ce, "Malam Haruna, ranar idi bayan sallah, mahauta za su taru a gidana. Ina so ka zo da 'yan kiɗanka ku yi mana waƙa."

Malam Haruna ya ce, "Da yardar Allah zan zo."

Washegari ya je kasuwar mahauta domin ya ga yadda suke shiri. Ya ga wani babban garke na raguna a gefen kasuwa. Wani mahauci ya ce masa, "Wannan garke na Alhaji Sanusi ne. Zai yanka su ranar idi, ya raba naman ga talakawan unguwa." Malam Haruna ya rubuta wannan a cikin waƙarsa: "Garken Sanusi ya cika fili, ba wanda zai kwana da yunwa."

Ya kuma ga mata suna niƙa barkono domin tsire. Wani mahauci ya yi dariya ya ce, "Tsire ba tare da barkono ba, ba tsire ba ne." Malam Haruna ma ya yi dariya, ya saka barkono a cikin waƙarsa.

Ranar idi, bayan sallar idi, mutane suka taru a gidan Alhaji Sanusi. Yara sun zo da sababbin kaya. Alhaji Sanusi ya raba wa yara alawa, kowane yaro ya sami alawa uku. A cikin yaran akwai wani bebe mai suna Ɗanbala. Bebe ne tun haihuwarsa, ba ya magana, amma idan ya ji ganga yakan yi rawa. Ya karɓi alawarsa, ya ruga wurin mahaifiyarsa yana dariya.

Sai Malam Haruna da 'yan kiɗansa suka fara. Ganga ta yi ƙara, kakaki ya busa. Malam Haruna ya yabi Alhaji Sanusi: "Sanusi mai kwarjini, shugaban mahauta!" Sannan ya yabi mahauta gaba ɗaya: "Mahauci shi ne mai ciyar da gari. Hakazalika, mahauci shi ne mai ba matafiya tsire mai barkono. Hakazalika, mahauci ne yake ba talaka nama ranar idi."

Mutane suka yi ta tafi. Ɗanbala, yaron nan bebe, ya fara rawa a gaban 'yan kiɗa. Da waƙar ta kai kololuwarta, sai Alhaji Sanusi ya tashi ya yi rawa a tsakiyar fili tare da Ɗanbala, mahauta duka suka bi su. Tsofaffin mahauta sun ce ba su taɓa ganin shugabansu yana rawa haka ba.

Bayan waƙar, Alhaji Sanusi ya rungume Malam Haruna, ya ba shi babban rago daga cikin garkensa. Da dare Malam Haruna ya ce wa matarsa, "Na yi waƙa shekara talatin, amma yau ce kololuwar rayuwata ta mawaƙi."

Tambayoyi:
Wane irin mutum ne Alhaji Sanusi?
Mutum ne mai kwarjini, kuma shi ne shugaban mahauta.
Na wa ne garken raguna da ke gefen kasuwa?
Garken na Alhaji Sanusi ne.
Me ya sa mata suke niƙa barkono?
Suna niƙa barkono domin tsire.
Me Alhaji Sanusi ya raba wa yara ranar idi?
Ya raba musu alawa, kowane yaro ya sami alawa uku.
Me Alhaji Sanusi ya yi da waƙar ta kai kololuwarta?
Ya tashi ya yi rawa a tsakiyar fili tare da Ɗanbala, yaron bebe.

lessons.title: Waƙar da aka dawo da ita
lessons.summary: In Kano, the board that checks songs before release meets about a young singer's new video; the member Malama Ruƙayya asks who the singer is, and the secretary Malam Tasiu reads from his records that the song is hers; the topic is love, but the video shows nakedness, the words call a rival singer a hurtful name, which Ruƙayya explains, and accuse her of theft with no proof; Hafiza agrees to change them and the song is approved.
lessons.text:
A Kano akwai wata hukuma da take duba waƙoƙi da fina-finai kafin a sayar da su a kasuwa. Kowace Talata membobinta sukan zauna a wani ɗaki suna kallon sababbin bidiyo.

A wannan Talata, magatakardar hukumar, Malam Tasiu, ya shigo da wani faifai. Shi ne magatakarda tun shekara goma, kuma shi ne yake rubuta duk abin da aka yanke a taro.

Malama Ruƙayya, ɗaya daga cikin membobin hukumar, ta ga hoton wata matashiya a kan faifan. Ta tambaya, "Wacece wannan?"

Magatakardar ya duba takardunsa. "Sunanta Hafiza. Sabuwar mawaƙiya ce daga Fagge."

"Waƙar tata ce, ko ta wani ce?"

"Ee, tata ce. Ita ce ta rubuta kalmomin, ita ce kuma ta rera."

Suka kunna bidiyon. Maudu'in waƙar soyayya ne: wata yarinya tana jiran saurayinta wanda ya tafi aiki a Legas. Malama Ruƙayya ta ce, "Maudu'in yana da kyau. Mutane suna son irin wannan maudu'i."

Amma a tsakiyar bidiyon, wasu 'yan rawa suka fito da kayan da ba su rufe jikinsu ba. Malama Ruƙayya ta ce, "Wannan tsiraici ne. Doka ba ta yarda da tsiraici a bidiyon da za a sayar wa iyalai ba."

Sannan suka saurari kalmomin waƙar da kyau. A wani wuri Hafiza ta yi magana a kan wata mawaƙiya, Jummai. Malam Tasiu ya tambaya, "Wacece Jummai?" Malama Ruƙayya ta ce, "Mawaƙiya ce wadda suke hamayya da ita." A cikin waƙar, Hafiza ta kira Jummai da kalmar nan shege. Malama Ruƙayya ta girgiza kai. "Kun san ma'anar shege? Shege yaro ne da aka haifa ba tare da aure ba. A ƙasar Hausa wannan babban zagi ne. Ba a kiran kowa shege sai don a ci mutuncinsa."

A wani wuri kuma waƙar ta ce Jummai ta saci kuɗin wani mai shirya fina-finai. Malam Tasiu ya ce, "Shin akwai shaida?"

"Babu," in ji Malama Ruƙayya. "Wannan ƙazafi ne. Ƙazafi laifi ne a gaban doka, kuma Jummai za ta iya kai ta kotu."

Hukumar ta kira Hafiza. Ta zo tare da mahaifinta. Malama Ruƙayya ta yi mata bayani: "Waƙarki tana da daɗi, kuma muryarki tana da kyau. Amma dole ki cire tsiraicin da ke cikin bidiyon, ki cire kalmar shege, ki kuma cire ƙazafin da kika yi wa Jummai."

Hafiza ta yi shiru na ɗan lokaci, sannan ta tambaya, "Idan na gyara ta, waƙar za ta ci gaba da zama tata?"

"Ee, tata ce. Babu wanda zai karɓe ta daga hannunki."

"To, zan gyara. Ban yi tunanin haka ba."

Bayan mako biyu ta dawo da sabon bidiyo. Babu tsiraici, babu zagi, babu ƙazafi. Malam Tasiu ya rubuta a cikin littafinsa: "An yarda a sayar da waƙar."

Tambayoyi:
Wacece Hafiza?
Sabuwar mawaƙiya ce daga Fagge.
Me ne ne maudu'in waƙarta?
Maudu'in soyayya ne: yarinya tana jiran saurayinta.
Me ya sa Malama Ruƙayya ta ce bidiyon yana da tsiraici?
Domin wasu 'yan rawa sun fito da kayan da ba su rufe jikinsu ba.
Me ya sa kiran wani shege ba shi da kyau?
Domin babban zagi ne, ana faɗarsa ne don a ci mutuncin mutum.
Me Malam Tasiu ya rubuta a ƙarshe?
Ya rubuta cewa an yarda a sayar da waƙar.

lessons.title: Waƙar siyasa
lessons.summary: In Bauchi, before a party primary, the politician Alhaji Barau, who wants to lead the party in the state, offers the young singer Ɗanlami money for songs that call his rival a saboteur; Ɗanlami's old teacher Malam Ɗankabo tells him that this is propaganda and that a singer should not take sides; a newspaper then uncovers Barau's embezzlement as a council chairman, and Ɗanlami sings a song for peace at all the parties' processions instead.
lessons.text:
Ɗanlami matashin mawaƙi ne a Bauchi. Waƙoƙinsa na soyayya sun yi suna a gidajen rediyo. Wata biyu kafin zaɓen fid da gwani na wata babbar jam'iyya, wani ɗan siyasa mai suna Alhaji Barau ya gayyace shi gidansa.

Alhaji Barau ya ce, "Ina so in shugabantar da jam'iyyarmu a wannan jiha. Idan na ci zaɓen fid da gwani, zan zama ɗan takararta na gwamna. Ina so ka yi mini waƙoƙi."

Ya nuna wa Ɗanlami wasu fosta da aka buga hotonsa a kansu. "Za a liƙa waɗannan fosta a duk titunan Bauchi. Waƙarka kuma za ta riƙa tashi a rediyo kullum. Zan biya ka naira miliyan biyu."

Sannan ya ba shi takarda da ke ɗauke da kalmomin da yake so a saka a cikin waƙar. A cikin takardar an rubuta cewa abokin hamayyarsa ɓarawo ne, kuma yana yi wa jihar zagon ƙasa.

Ɗanlami ya koma gida da takardar. Da dare ya je wurin tsohon malaminsa, Malam Ɗankabo, wanda ya koya masa kiɗa. Malam Ɗankabo ya karanta takardar, sannan ya ce, "Ɗanlami, wannan ba waƙa ba ce, farfaganda ce. Farfaganda tana ɓata sunan mutane da ƙarya. Shin ka san cewa abokin hamayyarsa yana yi wa jihar zagon ƙasa?"

"Ban sani ba," in ji Ɗanlami.

"To, kada ka faɗi abin da ba ka sani ba. Kuma ka tuna, ya fi kyau mawaƙi ya guji ɓangaranci. Masoyanka suna cikin kowace jam'iyya. Idan ka shiga ɓangaranci, rabinsu za su ƙi ka."

Bayan kwana uku, wata jarida ta bankaɗo wani babban labari. 'Yan jarida sun bankaɗo cewa a lokacin da Alhaji Barau yake shugaban ƙaramar hukuma, an yi almundahana da kuɗin gina makarantu. Hukumar yaƙi da almundahana ta ce za ta yi bincike.

Ɗanlami ya ce wa Malam Ɗankabo, "Da na yi masa waƙar, da yanzu mutane suna cewa ni ma ina cikin almundahanar."

Ɗanlami ya mayar wa Alhaji Barau da takardarsa, ya ce ba zai yi waƙar ba. Maimakon haka, ya rubuta wata sabuwar waƙa mai suna "Zaɓe ba yaƙi ba ne." A cikin waƙar ya roƙi matasa su yi zaɓe lafiya, kada su yarda a yi amfani da su wajen tashin hankali.

A makon zaɓen fid da gwani, kowace jam'iyya ta yi jerin gwano a titunan Bauchi. Jerin gwano ɗaya yana da fosta ja, wani kuma yana da kore. Amma a kowane jerin gwano, matasa suna rera waƙar Ɗanlami.

Alhaji Barau bai sami damar shugabantar da jam'iyyar ba.

Malam Ɗankabo ya yi murmushi. "Ka gani? Yanzu waƙarka ta kowa ce, babu ɓangaranci a cikinta."

Tambayoyi:
Me Alhaji Barau yake so ya yi?
Yana so ya shugabantar da jam'iyyarsu a jihar, ya zama ɗan takarar gwamna.
Me aka rubuta a cikin takardar da ya ba Ɗanlami?
An rubuta cewa abokin hamayyarsa ɓarawo ne, kuma yana yi wa jihar zagon ƙasa.
Me Malam Ɗankabo ya ce game da takardar?
Ya ce ba waƙa ba ce, farfaganda ce.
Me jaridar ta bankaɗo?
Ta bankaɗo cewa an yi almundahana da kuɗin gina makarantu a lokacin da Alhaji Barau yake shugaban ƙaramar hukuma.
Wace waƙa matasa suke rerawa a jerin gwano?
Suna rera waƙar Ɗanlami, "Zaɓe ba yaƙi ba ne."

lessons.title: Kiɗan girbi
lessons.summary: In a village near Katsina, the farmer Alhaji Ɗahiru calls a work party to harvest his millet and his wetland farm, and the drummer Malam Ɗanjaji and his men drum to keep the workers going; they rest under a tamarind tree, wade through the mud of the wetland, weigh ninety sacks of millet, fill the granaries, and Ɗahiru plans to enlarge the farm next year.
lessons.text:
Alhaji Ɗahiru manomi ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina. Yana da babbar gonar gero a bayan ƙauyen, da kuma wata fadama a bakin kogi, inda yake noman shinkafa da albasa. A wannan shekara damina ta yi kyau, geron ya nuna.

Alhaji Ɗahiru ya kira gayya. Matasa talatin suka zo domin su taimaka masa wajen girbin geron. Ya kuma kira Malam Ɗanjaji, mai kiɗan noma, tare da 'yan kiɗansa uku. Malam Ɗanjaji ya ce, "Manomi ba ya gajiya idan ya ji ganga."

Da safe matasan suka fara yanke geron, Malam Ɗanjaji yana buga ganga a bayansu. Yana rera waƙa yana kiran sunan kowane matashi: "Ga Ɗanbaba, ga Tanimu, mai sauri kamar iska!" Duk wanda ya ji sunansa sai ya ƙara ƙarfi.

Da rana ta yi zafi, suka huta a ƙarƙashin wata babbar tsamiya a tsakiyar gonar. Matar Alhaji Ɗahiru ta kawo musu ruwan tsamiya mai sanyi da abinci. Malam Ɗanjaji ya ce, "Wannan tsamiya ta girmi kowa a ƙauyen nan. Kakana ma yakan huta a ƙarƙashinta."

Da yamma suka tafi fadama. Ƙasar fadama ba kamar ta gonar gero ba ce: duk laka ce. Matasan sun shiga laka har gwiwa. 'Yan kiɗan ma sun shiga laka da ganguna a kafaɗunsu. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya faɗi a cikin laka, kowa ya yi dariya, shi ma ya yi dariya, ya ci gaba da kiɗa.

Bayan kwana biyar aka gama girbi. Alhaji Ɗahiru ya kira wani ɗan kasuwa da ma'auni domin a yi awon geron. Aka yi awo buhu ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Da aka gama awo, ɗan kasuwar ya ce, "Buhu casa'in!" A bara buhu sittin kacal Alhaji Ɗahiru ya samu. Yanzu ya sami casa'in.

Suka kai geron cikin rumbu. Alhaji Ɗahiru yana da rumbu uku a gidansa, kuma duka suka cika. Ya ce, "Ban taɓa ganin rumbuna sun cika haka ba."

Da dare Malam Ɗanjaji ya yi waƙa a ƙofar gidan Alhaji Ɗahiru. Ya rera: "An samu yalwa, an samu gero, rumbu sun cika, Allah mun gode!" Mutanen ƙauye suka taru suna rawa. Wani tsoho ya ce, "Shekara goma ba a ga yalwa irin ta bana ba. Yalwar nan ta shiga kowane gida."

Alhaji Ɗahiru ya ce wa Malam Ɗanjaji, "Baɗi zan yalwata gonata. Zan sayi wani fili a gefen fadama. Kuma baɗi ma kai ne za ka buga mana ganga."

Malam Ɗanjaji ya ce, "Allah ya yalwata mana arziki, ya kai mu baɗi lafiya."

Tambayoyi:
Ina fadamar Alhaji Ɗahiru take?
Tana bakin kogi, inda yake noman shinkafa da albasa.
Ina suka huta da rana ta yi zafi?
Sun huta a ƙarƙashin wata babbar tsamiya a tsakiyar gonar.
Me ya sa ƙasar fadama ba kamar ta gonar gero ba ce?
Domin duk laka ce, matasan sun shiga laka har gwiwa.
Buhu nawa aka samu bayan awo?
An samu buhu casa'in.
Me Alhaji Ɗahiru zai yi baɗi?
Zai yalwata gonarsa, ya sayi wani fili a gefen fadama.

lessons.title: Waƙar kaguwa
lessons.summary: In a village near Gombe, Kaka Tani tells her grandchildren Hansai and Mamman a folk tale with a song: a witch turns into a hyena at night and kills the villagers' goats; a small crab sees her change at the river, and when she takes snake venom to poison the well, the crab crawls all night to the chief's door and sings what it saw; the chief sends his son for the hunters, they surround the witch's house, and she flees for ever. The lesson: do not look down on any small creature.
lessons.text:
A lokacin damina, kowane dare bayan cin abinci, jikokin Kaka Tani sukan taru a gabanta a tsakar gida domin ta ba su tatsuniya. A daren nan Hansai ta ce, "Kaka, ki ba mu tatsuniyar kaguwa da mayya." Ɗan'uwanta Mamman ya ce, "Ee, wadda take da waƙa!"

Kaka Tani ta yi murmushi, ta fara:

A zamanin da, a wani ƙauye a bakin kogi, akwai wata mata da take zaune ita kaɗai. Mutanen ƙauyen ba su san cewa mayya ce ba. Kowane dare, da kowa ya yi barci, sai mayyar ta fita bayan gari, ta rikiɗe ta zama kura. Sannan kurar ta shiga ƙauyen, ta karkashe awakin mutane da tumakinsu.

Da safe mutane sukan tarar da awakinsu a mace. Suka ce, "Wata kura ce take karkashe dabbobinmu." Mafarauta sun bi sawun kurar, amma sawun bai kai su daji ba. Ya koma cikin ƙauyen.

A cikin kogin akwai wata ƙaramar kaguwa. Wani dare kaguwar ta ga matar ta zo bakin kogi, ta rera wata waƙa, sannan ta rikiɗe ta zama kura. Kaguwar ta ji tsoro, ta ɓoye a cikin laka. A cikin dukan talikan kogin, babu wanda ya fi ta ƙanƙanta.

Wata rana sarkin ƙauye ya fara zargin matar. Da mayyar ta ji haka, sai ta yi niyyar kashe mutanen ƙauyen gaba ɗaya. Ta kama wani maciji, ta cire dafinsa, ta ce, "Da dare zan zuba wannan dafi a cikin rijiyar ƙauye." Kaguwar tana jin ta daga cikin kogi.

Kaguwar ta fito daga ruwa, ta fara rarrafe zuwa ƙauye. Kun san kaguwa ba ta tafiya gaba, sai dai rarrafe a gefe. Ta yi ta rarrafe dukan dare har ta isa ƙofar gidan sarki. A nan ta rera waƙa:

"Mayya ta rikiɗe, ta zama kura,
ta kawo dafi, za ta zuba a rijiya!"

Sarki ya farka ya ji waƙar. Ya kira ɗansa ya ce, "Jeka ka kira mafarauta duka!" Sannan ya ƙara cewa, "Jeka kuma ka faɗa wa kowa kada ya sha ruwan rijiya yau!"

Mafarauta suka zo da kibiyoyinsu, suka dabaibaye gidan matar. Da kurar ta fito, ta ga mafarauta sun dabaibaye ta ta kowane gefe. Sai ta sake rikiɗewa ta koma mace, ta gudu ta bar ƙauyen, ba a ƙara ganinta ba har abada.

Kaka Tani ta ce, "Darasin tatsuniyar shi ne: kada ka raina kowane taliki. Allah ya ba kowane taliki aikinsa, ko ƙarami ne kamar kaguwa."

Mamman ya tambaya, "Kaka, akwai mayya a gaskiya?"

Kaka ta yi dariya. "Tatsuniya ce kawai. To, yanzu jeka ka kwanta."

Tambayoyi:
Me mayyar take yi kowane dare?
Takan rikiɗe ta zama kura, ta karkashe awakin mutane da tumakinsu.
Me kaguwar ta gani a bakin kogi?
Ta ga matar ta rera waƙa, sannan ta rikiɗe ta zama kura.
Me mayyar ta so ta yi da dafin maciji?
Ta so ta zuba shi a cikin rijiyar ƙauye.
Yaya kaguwar ta isa gidan sarki?
Ta yi ta rarrafe a gefe dukan dare har ta isa ƙofar gidansa.
Me mafarauta suka yi?
Sun dabaibaye gidan matar ta kowane gefe.

lessons.title: Wanda ya musulunta saboda waƙa
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the mechanic Chinedu from Enugu has listened for years to Malam Sirajo's radio songs about the oneness of God and the Hijra; one day he tells Sirajo he wants to become a Muslim, explains that the songs were the cause, tells his mother in Enugu, who wishes him peace, and takes the name Abdullahi at the mosque; Sirajo writes a new song asking God to guide everyone.
lessons.text:
Malam Sirajo mawaƙin yabon Annabi ne a Sokoto. A al'adance, mawaƙan yabo a ƙasar Hausa sukan rera waƙoƙinsu a tarukan addini, ba tare da ganga ba, sai dai da murya kawai. Haka Malam Sirajo yake yi. Waƙoƙinsa sun fi magana a kan tauhidi, wato cewa Allah ɗaya ne, ba shi da abokin tarayya, da kuma labarin hijra, lokacin da Annabi ya bar Makka ya tafi Madina.

Ma'abota waƙoƙinsa suna da yawa. Kowane daren Alhamis yakan rera waƙa a gidan rediyo, kuma ma'abota sauraren shirin sukan kira waya daga jihohi daban daban.

A kan titin gidan Malam Sirajo akwai wata bitar gyaran mota ta wani mutumin Enugu mai suna Chinedu. Chinedu ya zo Sokoto shekara goma sha biyar da suka wuce. Shi Kirista ne, amma yana jin Hausa sosai. Duk lokacin da yake aiki, rediyonsa a kunne yake.

Wata rana bayan sallar magariba, Chinedu ya zo ƙofar gidan Malam Sirajo. Ya ce, "Malam, ina so in musulunta."

Malam Sirajo ya yi mamaki. Ya ce, "Ka zauna. Me ne ne musabbabin wannan niyya?"

Chinedu ya ce, "Shekara biyar ina sauraron waƙoƙinka a rediyo. Waƙarka ta tauhidi ta sa na fara tunani. Waƙarka ta hijra kuma ta sa na sayi littattafai na karanta tarihin Annabi. Waƙoƙinka su ne sila. Su ne suka fara buɗe mini ido."

Malam Sirajo ya ce, "Abin farin ciki ne. Amma addini ba wasa ba ne, kuma ba a tilasta wa kowa. Ka je ka faɗa wa iyayenka tukuna. Ba na so ka musulunta a ɓoye."

Chinedu ya tafi Enugu ya faɗa wa mahaifiyarsa. Ta yi kuka, sannan ta ce, "Ɗana, abin da nake so a gare ka shi ne salama. Idan wannan zai ba ka salama a zuciyarka, ban hana ka ba."

Da ya dawo Sokoto, ya je masallaci tare da Malam Sirajo. A gaban limami ya yi kalmar shahada, ya musulunta, ya kuma ɗauki sunan Abdullahi. A al'adance, idan wani ya musulunta a ƙasar Hausa, maƙwabta sukan kawo masa kyautai. Haka aka yi masa: an kawo masa riguna, carbi da Alƙur'ani.

Limamin ya ce masa, "Mumini na gaskiya shi ne wanda yake girmama iyayensa. Ka ci gaba da ziyartar mahaifiyarka." Abdullahi ya ce zai riƙa ziyartarta, domin yana so ya zama mumini na gaskiya.

A wannan daren Alhamis, Malam Sirajo ya faɗa wa ma'abota shirinsa cewa waƙa tana iya zama sila, wato musabbabin shiriya. Sannan ya rera sabuwar waƙa: "Ya Allah ka shiryar da mu, ka shiryar da 'ya'yanmu, ka shiryar da duk wanda yake nemanka."

Tambayoyi:
Me waƙoƙin Malam Sirajo suka fi magana a kai?
Sun fi magana a kan tauhidi da labarin hijra.
Me ne ne musabbabin niyyar Chinedu ta musulunta?
Waƙoƙin Malam Sirajo da ya ji a rediyo, su ne sila.
Me ya sa Malam Sirajo ya ce Chinedu ya je ya faɗa wa iyayensa?
Domin ba ya so ya musulunta a ɓoye, kuma ba a tilasta wa kowa addini.
Me mahaifiyar Chinedu take so a gare shi?
Tana so ya sami salama a zuciyarsa.
Wane suna Chinedu ya ɗauka?
Ya ɗauki sunan Abdullahi.
Me ya sa Abdullahi zai ci gaba da ziyartar mahaifiyarsa?
Domin mumini na gaskiya yana girmama iyayensa.

lessons.title: Gasar mawaƙan makaranta
lessons.summary: In Zaria, thirteen-year-old Nusaiba leads her school choir in a competition; two days before it she catches a cold with a runny nose, and her mother Hajiya Saratu cooks her a hot pepper soup to drink up and rubs cream on her sore nose; on the morning of the contest Nusaiba gets her first period, and her mother calmly explains it and tells her it is no reason to stay away; at the hall the teacher has the girls warm up their voices, Nusaiba raises her voice, and her school wins.
lessons.text:
Nusaiba 'yar shekara goma sha uku ce, kuma ita ce babbar mawaƙiyar ƙungiyar mawaƙan makarantarsu a Zaria. A ranar Asabar za a yi gasar mawaƙan makarantun jihar a babban zauren birnin.

Malamarsu ta kiɗa, Malama Hannatu, ta ce wa 'yan matan, "Daga yau har ranar gasar, ba wadda za ta fasa zuwa atisaye sai da larura. Idan akwai larura, ku sanar da ni tun da wuri." Sannan ta ƙara da cewa, "Yanzu ku tafi gida ku huta. Sai anjima a atisayen yamma."

Ranar Alhamis Nusaiba ta kamu da mura. Majina tana zuba daga hancinta, kuma muryarta ta yi rauni. Ta yi ta goge majina har hancinta ya yi ja yana ciwo. Ta ce, "Mama, yaya zan rera waƙa da wannan majina?"

Mahaifiyarta, Hajiya Saratu, ta shiga ɗakin girki. Ta girka mata miyar barkono mai zafi da citta da tafarnuwa. Ta ce, "Ki shanye ta duka, kada ki rage." Nusaiba ta shanye miyar, gumi ya fito mata a goshi. Da dare ta sake girka mata wata miya, Nusaiba ta sake shanye ta.

Sannan Hajiya Saratu ta fito da wani cream, ta shafa wa Nusaiba a hanci. "Wannan cream zai sa fatar hancinki ta yi laushi, ciwon ya ragu." Kafin ta kwanta, Nusaiba ta sake shafa cream ɗin.

Ranar Asabar da safe, mura ta ragu. Amma da Nusaiba ta tashi, sai ta ga jini, kuma cikinta yana ciwo. Ta firgita, ta kira mahaifiyarta. Hajiya Saratu ta zauna kusa da ita a kan gado, ta yi mata bayani a hankali: "Kada ki ji tsoro. Wannan haila ce. Kowace yarinya takan fara haila a wannan shekaru. Alama ce ta girma." Ta nuna mata yadda za ta kula da kanta.

Nusaiba ta tambaya, "Mama, haila larura ce da za ta hana ni zuwa gasa?"

Mahaifiyarta ta yi murmushi. "A'a. Haila ba larura ba ce da za ta hana ki waƙa. Idan cikinki ya yi ciwo sosai, ki gaya wa Malama Hannatu."

A zauren gasar, kafin su hau dandali, Malama Hannatu ta ce, "Ku ɗumama murya tukuna. Murya kamar abinci ce, sai an ɗumama ta." Suka ɗumama murya da wasu gajerun waƙoƙi.

Da lokacinsu ya yi, malamar ta ɗaga hannu, Nusaiba ta ɗaga murya, sauran 'yan mata suka bi ta. A ƙarshen waƙar, duk 'yan kallo suka ɗaga hannu suna tafi.

Alƙalai suka ce makarantar Nusaiba ce ta yi nasara. Malama Hannatu ta rungume ta ta ce, "Ku tafi gida ku huta yanzu. Sai anjima, za mu yi bikin nasara a makaranta."

Tambayoyi:
Wane abu kaɗai zai sa wata yarinya ta fasa zuwa atisaye?
Larura kaɗai, kuma sai ta sanar da Malama Hannatu tun da wuri.
Me Hajiya Saratu ta girka wa Nusaiba?
Ta girka mata miyar barkono mai zafi da citta da tafarnuwa.
Me ya sa Hajiya Saratu ta shafa mata cream a hanci?
Domin fatar hancinta ta yi laushi, ciwon ya ragu.
Me Hajiya Saratu ta faɗa wa Nusaiba game da haila?
Ta ce kowace yarinya takan fara haila a wannan shekaru, kuma ba larura ba ce da za ta hana ta waƙa.
Me Malama Hannatu ta ce su yi kafin su hau dandali?
Ta ce su ɗumama murya tukuna.

lessons.title: Bikin waƙa a Jos
lessons.summary: The singer Zakariyya and his band travel from Kaduna to a concert in Jos: an old tyre bursts and the guitarist Faruk injures his hand changing it, the drummer Gambo has diarrhoea, the hall's store key is lost, the generator that should start automatically fails when the power goes, the audience lights candles, Faruk's bottle of soda foams over, and the band plays without loudspeakers; the next day the papers praise the night.
lessons.text:
Zakariyya mawaƙi ne a Kaduna, kuma yana da ƙungiyar kiɗa ta mutum uku: shi, mai jita Faruk, da mai ganga Gambo. An gayyace su Jos domin su yi waƙa a babban zauren birnin ranar Asabar.

Suka shiga ƙaramar motarsu da safe. Faruk ya duba tayoyin motar, ya ce, "Waɗannan tayoyi sun tsufa. Ya kamata mu sayi sababbin tayoyi." Zakariyya ya ce, "Ba mu da lokaci. Za mu saya a Jos."

Da suka kai rabin hanya, sai wata taya ta fashe. Suka tsaya a gefen hanya. Faruk ya fito da tayar ajiya, amma yayin da yake canza ta, sai ƙarfe ya raunata masa hannu. Jini ya fito. Gambo ya ɗaure masa hannun da tsumma. Faruk ya ce, "Ban ji ciwo sosai ba. Ƙarfen ya raunata fata kawai. Zan iya kaɗa jita."

Amma Gambo ma ba shi da lafiya. Tun daren jiya yake gudawa saboda wani abinci da ya ci a kasuwa. Sau uku suka tsaya a hanya saboda gudawarsa. A wani ƙauye suka sayi magani, suka kuma sayi sababbin tayoyi biyu.

Da suka isa zauren, mai kula da zauren ya ce, "Lasifikan suna cikin ɗakin ajiya, amma na rasa mabuɗin ɗakin." Suka yi ta neman mabuɗi na awa ɗaya. A ƙarshe aka sami mabuɗin a cikin motarsa.

Kafin a fara, Faruk ya ɗauki kwalbar lemu, ya buɗe ta da mabuɗi. Kumfa ya fito ya zuba a kan hannunsa da aka ɗaure. Kowa ya yi dariya. Faruk ya ce, "Kumfan nan ya fi ƙarfe ciwo!"

Aka fara bikin, mutane sun cika zauren. Bayan waƙa ta uku, sai wutar lantarki ta ɗauke. Duhu ya rufe zauren. Mai kula da zauren ya yi ihu, "Kada ku damu! Injin wutarmu yana tashi atomatik idan aka ɗauke wuta!" Amma injin bai tashi ba. Bai tashi atomatik ba, kuma bai tashi da hannu ba.

Sai wata tsohuwa a gaba ta fito da kyandir daga jakarta, ta kunna. Mutane suka fara kunna kyandir da fitilun wayoyinsu. Ba da daɗewa ba zauren ya cika da ƙananan fitilu.

Zakariyya ya ce, "Babu lasifika, amma muna da murya!" Faruk ya kaɗa jitarsa da hannu ɗaya, Gambo ya buga ganga a hankali, Zakariyya ya rera waƙa ba tare da lasifika ba. Mutane suka yi shiru suna sauraro, sannan suka fara rera waƙar tare da shi.

Washe gari jaridun Jos suka rubuta labarin "daren kyandir". Washe gari kuma mutane da yawa suka kira Zakariyya suna cewa ba su taɓa jin daɗin waƙa kamar haka ba. Washe gari kuma Gambo ya warke daga gudawa.

Tambayoyi:
Me Faruk ya ce game da tayoyin motar?
Ya ce sun tsufa, ya kamata a sayi sababbin tayoyi.
Me ya raunata hannun Faruk?
Ƙarfe ne ya raunata masa hannu lokacin da yake canza taya.
Me ya sa suka tsaya sau uku a hanya?
Saboda gudawar Gambo.
Ina aka sami mabuɗin ɗakin ajiya?
An same shi a cikin motar mai kula da zauren.
Me ya faru da Faruk ya buɗe kwalbar lemu?
Kumfa ya fito ya zuba a kan hannunsa.
Me mutane suka yi da wutar lantarki ta ɗauke?
Sun kunna kyandir da fitilun wayoyinsu.

lessons.title: Kaset ɗin jabu
lessons.summary: In Kano, the old singer Malam Ɗanliti lives in poverty while traders sell fake copies of his songs at a discount; his granddaughter Fadila, a lawyer, is warned to be careful when she asks where they come from, gets directions to a warehouse from a young trader, takes them to the police, and they seal off a warehouse holding twenty thousand fake discs; the cowardly boss Alhaji Ɗanzaki runs off and leaves his workers, is caught, and a court makes him pay the singer.
lessons.text:
A shekarun da suka wuce, Malam Ɗanliti yana ɗaya daga cikin manyan mawaƙan Kano. Ana jin waƙoƙinsa a kowane gida da kowace mota. Amma yanzu ya tsufa, kuma yana cikin fatara. Gidansa ya fara rushewa, wani lokaci kuma ba shi da kuɗin magani.

Jikarsa Fadila lauya ce. Wata rana ta je kasuwa, sai ta ga ana sayar da faifan waƙoƙin kakanta ko'ina. Ta ɗauki ɗaya ta duba shi. Hoton kakanta yana kansa, amma takardar ba ta da kyau, kuma sunansa an rubuta shi ba daidai ba. Ta gane cewa wannan faifai jabu ne.

Dillalan kaset da faifai suna ta kira, "Rangwame! Rangwame! Faifan Ɗanliti naira ɗari biyu kawai!" Da rangwamen nan, ba wanda zai sayi na gaskiya.

Fadila ta tambayi wani matashi daga cikin dillalan, "Wa yake yin waɗannan faifai?"

Matashin ya kalle ta, ya rage murya ya ce, "Hattara, Hajiya. Kada ki tambayi haka a kasuwar nan. Masu yin faifan jabu suna da ƙarfi." Amma da yamma matashin ya kira ta a waya, ya ba ta kwatancen wani ɗakin ajiya a bayan kasuwa: "Ki bi titin masallaci, ki juya hagu a gidan mai, ƙofar ja ce." Wani daga cikin dillalan kuma ya ce mata, "Hattara! Ki sayi abinki ki tafi."

Fadila ta koma gida ta faɗa wa kakanta. Malam Ɗanliti ya girgiza kai. "Waɗannan dillalan suna cin gumina, ni kuma ina cikin fatara. Amma me zan iya yi?"

Fadila ta ce, "Kaka, doka tana tare da kai. Waƙoƙinka naka ne." Ta kai ƙara ga 'yan sanda, ta ba su kwatancen da matashin ya ba ta.

'Yan sanda suka bi kwatancen, suka gano ɗakin ajiyar. Da asuba suka killace ɗakin ta kowane gefe, domin kada wani ya fita. Bayan sun killace shi, suka shiga. A ciki suka sami faifan jabu fiye da dubu ishirin, da injunan da ake yin su.

Mai ɗakin, Alhaji Ɗanzaki, yana ciki tare da yaransa. Da ya ga 'yan sanda, sai ya ruga ta ƙofar baya, ya bar yaransa a hannun 'yan sanda. Wani ɗan sanda ya ce, "Matsoraci ne kawai yake guduwa ya bar yaransa." Bayan kwana uku aka kama matsoracin a gidan wani abokinsa a Kaduna.

A kotu, alƙali ya ce Alhaji Ɗanzaki ya biya Malam Ɗanliti diyya, kuma a ƙone faifan jabu dubu ishirin ɗin a gaban jama'a.

Da kuɗin diyyar, Malam Ɗanliti ya gyara gidansa, fatararsa ta ƙare. Ya ce a rediyo, "Ina gode wa jikata. Ga masu sayen faifan jabu kuma, hattara: kuna cutar da mawaƙan da kuke so."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya rayuwar Malam Ɗanliti take yanzu?
Ya tsufa, kuma yana cikin fatara.
Yaya Fadila ta gane cewa faifan jabu ne?
Takardar ba ta da kyau, kuma an rubuta sunan kakanta ba daidai ba.
Me matashin ya ce mata?
Ya ce, "Hattara, kada ki tambayi haka a kasuwar nan."
Me 'yan sanda suka yi da asuba?
Sun killace ɗakin ajiyar ta kowane gefe.
Faifan jabu nawa 'yan sanda suka samu?
Sun sami faifan jabu fiye da dubu ishirin.
Me ya sa ɗan sanda ya kira Alhaji Ɗanzaki matsoraci?
Domin ya gudu ta ƙofar baya ya bar yaransa a hannun 'yan sanda.
